notes.title: Woodle Tree 2 Update 1.0! - Full release!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello my friends!
I'm happy to let you know that we just released the final version of Woodle Tree 2: Worlds! ːwoodlefatherː


Here some of the improvements:

[b]
- MMO mode now fully available! (To enter it, simply touch the 3 Woodle statue at the main plaza)
- New Map!
- New Woodle's friends 
- New Triple Attack move
- Camera movements options
- Woodle's animations perfected
- Improved loading times
- General bug fixes
[/b]

I really hope you'll like this new release :)
have a nice day ːwoodleː
MalboM


[/h1]

notes.title: Woodle Tree 2 Update 0.9! - MMO Mode
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello my friends! 
I'm happy to announce a new update for the game!  

We hope you're enjoying the game so far, we're constantly adding more and more content to the game based on your feedback! 

Here some of the new features with this release!
[b]
- MMO Alpha mode now available! (simply touch the 3 Woodle statue at the center of the plaza to enter MMO mode) 
- New menu!
- Improved frame rate
- General bug fixes
[/b]

let us know what would you like to see in the final version of the game! 
(to be released in semptember)
[/h1]
